narration:0:1460701001:0.text: Wandering traveler, the hour has come to remember your home's call... Return now, to the place you first swore to protect...
narration:0:1460701001:0.source_cn: 迷途的旅人啊，是时候想起家园的方向了……归来吧，回到你...

narration:1:1460701002:0.text: A strange voice whispers in your mind. You and Dolly follow its pull, arriving somewhere new... yet it feels like you've always known it.
